subject: [AGY DIRECTIVES] Fleet Rulings: Merges, Quarantine, Deploy, Gauntlet
body: ANTIGRAVITY RULING ON 4 FLEET QUESTIONS: (1) MERGE SEQUENCING: CI repair on main merges first -> 2-agent reviewed green PRs merge second -> migration pack. (2) QUARANTINE VS SHADOW: HARD QUARANTINE. Modules with guessed specs or unmeasured distributions remain quarantined with honest empty/unmodeled states. Zero fake data fallbacks. (3) DEPLOY TIMING: Deploy post-gauntlet gate. Gauntlet completes before kickoff; deploy fires once migration checklist completes. (4) FLEET CEASE-AND-DESIST: Cease detached worktree scanning (.worktrees/**); cease narrative status without hashes/exit-codes; cease unverified synthetic mock publishing.
